Integrate Codex activity leases

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-15
  description: |-
    Bind Codeon Codex App Server invocations to profile, operation, dispatch fence, exact thread, and exact turn activity observers. Normalize provider output, phases, dynamic tool lifecycle, trusted progress/completion, and terminal events into bounded durable activity ingress while preserving exact recovery and shared-process fail-closed termination behavior.
    
    Extend direct invocation recovery so daemon restart readback restores the observer for the persisted thread and turn. Keep observer and persistence backpressure off the App Server transport reader.
